svg.title: Cuber Hub
svg.desc: Cube colour order reference beside the Cuber Hub wordmark: blue, red, green, orange, blue, red. The first blue and last red are darker to indicate continuation; yellow above and white below. Horizontal lockup for bars and other low spaces. Dark background variant.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
